Author: baude
Posted: Tue Nov 17, 2026 7:53 am (GMT 0)

Fantastic work—congratulations, and a million thanks! Projects like this one—along with a few others we’ve seen around here—are exactly what make using AI worthwhile.

I’m certainly not one to demonize AI in this field; I understand why some people do, especially given that most results end up being incomplete or disappointing. But when you really put in the effort, know what you’re doing, and approach it with care and passion... it shows—it really shows! And this is a magnificent example of that.

Thanks again, and congratulations!
